title: How Many Times a Week? Stacking Frequency

sections.title: Combining two things you already know
sections.content: You already know the -nta/-nte time-frame words (naponta, hetente, havonta, évente) and the -szor/-szer/-ször count words (egyszer, kétszer, háromszor). Put them together and you can say exactly how many times something happens within a period: hetente kétszer ("twice a week"), naponta háromszor ("three times a day").

items.english: I go swimming twice a week.
We go to the cinema once a month.

sections.content: The order is fixed: the period word (hetente, naponta...) always comes first, then the count word (egyszer, kétszer...). Reversing them — kétszer hetente — sounds foreign, not just informal.
